rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, pretrain_steps=0, n_iter=50, grad_clip=1.0, outer_wall_s=1400, per_scene_s=None, batch_size=1, lr=0.0001, optimizer=adam, unet_c=16, train_n=400, val_n=200, seed=42, rationale=iter-13 SIX-BOX. (1) PRIOR: iter-12 hr=0.0, seed 42->314 variance check gave rmse=0.00629 (vs seed-42 ~0.00628) -- the ceiling is SEED-INDEPENDENT, confirming it is structural not a one-off RNG artifact. Iters 1-12 all hr=0. (2) FAILURE MODE: plain-UNet N2I regresses to the over-smoothed FBP mean; no edge-preserving structural guard (bilateral sibling range kernel hr~0.21). (3) ONE KNOB: relative to iter-6 best reference (n_iter=50, c=16, seed=42), lr 3e-4 -> 1e-4. Extends the lr sweep to its gentle end (iter-7=3e-3 up, iter-5/6=3e-4, now 1e-4). (4) HYPOTHESIS: a very gentle step size with the warm-started init may barely move off the (already over-smoothed) init in 50 steps, so rmse ~= the warm-start's own rmse; tests whether even minimal per-image adjustment can help. Per the ceiling, expect rmse ~0.0063 (hr=0) -- gentle steps neither escape nor worsen the over-smoothed basin. If unexpectedly lower, gentle-lr early-stop would be a lever worth a follow-up. (5) BUDGET: identical to iter-6 (n_iter=50 fast); ~12 min << 30-min wall. (6) Loop continues; iter-14 self-dispatched. Reserved levers: n_iter=400 high, pretrain_epochs=1 minimal, pretrain_steps cap, batch_size=2 warm-start, warm_start off + high n_iter.
